defect.observed_before_fix: With a cancel accepted while step 1 runs, a verified result from the Runner queued step 2.
defect.cause: _finish -> _advance ignored jobs.cancel_requested; continuation only checked state, verified and continue_next.
defect.fix: _finish passes cancel_requested; _advance ends the execution as cancelled instead of queueing the next step. The step keeps its real state, result and context.
defect.race: cancel_job and report_result both lock the job row (FOR UPDATE). Cancel first: result kept, no next step. Result first: next step queued, cancel of the finished step refused with 409 CONFLICT; the queued step can be cancelled.
defect.not_changed: Runner: cancel already reaches the Engine through the heartbeat for Engine-driven steps (procedure, template, notepad step). app_open, browser_open, report and notify are not interrupted mid-way; no retry, no undo.
